name: shared-continued
note: M7: the shared agent continued from G4's checkpoint on all three sizes, for comparison with the specialists at equal training. Same settings as the specialists but the table sizes: the learning rate restarts at 1e-4, the entropy bonus and the shaping stay where G4 ended them. 150 million decisions, a third at each size, so its check at 3D decisions compares with a specialist's at D; checked at every size.
